newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mobilcom says doubles H1 pretax profit.
newsitem.headline: Mobilcom says doubles H1 pretax profit.

text.p: German mobile phone startup Mobilcom AG said on Wednesday a wave of new customers helped profits more than double in the first half of 1997.
The company, whose shares are listed on Germany's fledgling midcap New Market exchange, reported pretax profit rose to 10.84 million marks from 5.2 million in the year-ago period.
After-tax profit for the first half totaled 5.42 million marks -- beating the 5.4 million marks totalled for all of 1996, the company said.
Earnings per share in the first half were 1.69 marks, compared to 84 pfennig a year ago.

With its customer count rising by 29,400 to 190,000, first-half revenue rose 25 percent to 147.8 million marks. Cash flow soared to 17.8 million marks from 8.8 million in the first six months last year.
Mobilcom shares on Tuesday closed at 132.20 marks, down 40 pfennig.
They were issued at 62.50 marks on March 10 when the Frankfurt bourse launched the New Market, an exchange for small and medium-sized firms and modelled after New York's NASDAQ exchange.
